meta.title: Rift Run
meta.instructions: Drag left and right to fly your starfighter down the canyon. It fires on its own. Shoot the drone waves, keep off the canyon walls, then break the Rift Core in wave 4.

colliders.body: concat(concat(map(drones, d => vec(d.x, d.y)), map(orbs, o => vec(o.x, o.y))), if in_wall() then [player] else [])

let.kind: if wave >= 3 and chance(0.3) then 'gunner' else if wave >= 2 and chance(0.4) then 'diver' else 'scout'

do.value: {id: seq, x: sx, y: -24.0, x0: sx, kind: kind, born: now, fired: false}

do.to: map(orbs, o => {...o, x: o.x + o.vx * s, y: o.y + o.vy * s})

map(drones, d => let ny = d.y + (if d.kind == 'diver' then 165.0 else if d.kind == 'gunner' then 95.0 else 120.0 + 10.0 * wave) * s in {...d, y: ny, x: clamp(if d.kind == 'diver' then d.x0 + clamp(player.x - d.x0, -90.0, 90.0) * clamp((ny - 100.0) / 260.0, 0.0, 1.0) else d.x0 + 34.0 * sin((now - d.born) / 430.0), wall_l(ny) + 18.0, wall_r(ny) - 18.0)})

rules.when: any(drones, d => d.kind == 'gunner' and not d.fired and d.y > 150.0)

do.for_each: filter(drones, d => d.kind == 'gunner' and not d.fired and d.y > 150.0)

do.value: {id: seq, x: g.x, y: g.y + 14.0, vx: aim.x * 200.0, vy: aim.y * 200.0}

do.to: map(drones, d => if d.kind == 'gunner' and d.y > 150.0 then {...d, fired: true} else d)

rules.when: any(drones, d => any(bolts, b => abs(b.x - d.x) < 18.0 and abs(b.y - d.y) < 20.0))

let.dead: filter(drones, d => any(bolts, b => abs(b.x - d.x) < 18.0 and abs(b.y - d.y) < 20.0))

do.where: b => any(dead, d => abs(b.x - d.x) < 18.0 and abs(b.y - d.y) < 20.0)

do.value: {id: seq, x: k.x, y: k.y - 10.0, born: now, text: '+' + str(10 + 5 * min(chain, 10))}

rules.when: not in_break and wave < 4 and to_spawn == 0 and len(drones) == 0
core_on and core_y > 60.0 and any(bolts, b => abs(b.x - core_x) < 40.0 and abs(b.y - core_y) < 34.0)

let.n: count(bolts, b => abs(b.x - core_x) < 40.0 and abs(b.y - core_y) < 34.0)

do.where: b => abs(b.x - core_x) < 40.0 and abs(b.y - core_y) < 34.0

then.value: {id: seq, x: core_x, y: core_y, born: now, text: 'CORE DOWN +' + str(300 + 100 * lives)}

do.value: {id: seq, x: core_x, y: core_y + 30.0, vx: cos(a + da) * 190.0, vy: sin(a + da) * 190.0}

template.frame: = if d.kind == 'scout' then 0 else if d.kind == 'diver' then 1 else 2
template.rotation: = if d.kind == 'scout' then 8.0 * cos((now - d.born) / 430.0) else 0.0

node.text: = if wave == 0 then 'Drones inbound' else if wave == 3 then 'Rift Core ahead!' else 'Wave ' + str(wave + 1) + ' incoming'

art.style: Sunset canyon run: plum rock walls with glowing orange rims over a deep rift with an ember river, a white-and-cyan starfighter, magenta drones with amber eyes, a hexagonal Rift Core.
